scientific.integrity: The primary full text and the theorem page were inspected at the state definition, Hamiltonian, Theorem 6.2, transversality conditions, stationarity formulas, and numerical optimal-control section. scientific.limitations: The result corrects the published necessary Pontryagin system. It does not reconstruct unavailable implementation code or recompute the numerical optimal-control trajectories.

title: The SQEIAR optimal-control adjoint is not the Hamiltonian gradient
